openwrt_git_ath79.nachricht:
ath79: Add support for OpenMesh A60

Device specifications:
======================

* Qualcomm/Atheros QCA9558 ver 1 rev 0
* 720/600/240 MHz (CPU/DDR/AHB)
* 128 MB of RAM
* 16 MB of SPI NOR flash
  - 2x 7 MB available; but one of the 7 MB regions is the recovery image
* 3T3R 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (11n)
* 3T3R 5 GHz Wi-Fi (11ac)
* multi-color LED (controlled via red/green/blue GPIOs)
* 1x GPIO-button (reset)
* external h/w watchdog (enabled by default))
* TTL pins are on board (arrow points to VCC, then follows: GND, TX, RX)
* 2x ethernet
  - eth0
    + Label: Ethernet 1
    + AR8035 ethernet PHY (RGMII)
    + 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet
    + 802.3af POE
    + used as WAN interface
  - eth1
    + Label: Ethernet 2
    + AR8031 ethernet PHY (SGMII)
    + 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet
    + used as LAN interface
* 1x USB
* internal antennas

Flashing instructions:
======================

Various methods can be used to install the actual image on the flash.
Two easy ones are:

ap51-flash
----------

The tool ap51-flash (https://github.com/ap51-flash/ap51-flash) should be
used to transfer the image to the u-boot when the device boots up.

initramfs from TFTP
-------------------

The serial console must be used to access the u-boot shell during bootup.
It can then be used to first boot up the initramfs image from a TFTP server
(here with the IP 192.168.1.21):

   setenv serverip 192.168.1.21
   setenv ipaddr 192.168.1.1
   tftpboot 0c00000 <filename-of-initramfs-kernel>.bin && bootm $fileaddr

The actual sysupgrade image can then be transferred (on the LAN port) to the
device via

  scp <filename-of-squashfs-sysupgrade>.bin root@192.168.1.1:/tmp/

On the device, the sysupgrade must then be started using

  sysupgrade -n /tmp/<filename-of-squashfs-sysupgrade>.bin

Signed-off-by: Sven Eckelmann <sven@narfation.org>

fcc_quickstart.strom: This access point requires 802.3af PoE input. Connect to an 802.3af-compatible PoE switch or PoE injector.
fcc_quickstart.ports: Ethernet port 1, 802.3af PoE; Ethernet port 2; USB 2.0; Reset Button (Übersichtsbild Rückseite)
fcc_quickstart.durchreichen: The pass-through port (Ethernet 2) is data only. No power is passed through the second port.
fcc_quickstart.abstrahlung: This access point radiates signal primarily to the front and sides. This access point will only provide limited coverage directly behind it.
fcc_quickstart.montage: Wall or solid ceiling mount; T-rail ceiling mount (9/16" und 15/16" Schienen); Ethernet or junction box mount (US single/dual gang, EU/UK); Mounting to any wall or pole with screws or zip ties (not included), rubber gasket around the ports
fcc_quickstart.hinweise: Do not install this access point in plenum spaces. Use the ceiling mount instead. Place the access point in the center of the room and away from any metallic surfaces.
fcc_quickstart.entriegeln: To unlock, insert a small, flat screwdriver into the hole on the side of the access point.
fcc_quickstart.lieferumfang_erwaehnt: small Ethernet cable (included), universal mounting plate

hersteller_seite.beschreibung: Simultaneous 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz wireless radios with 3x3 MIMO 802.11ac and 6 internal antennas. ... includes hardware watchdog, standard 802.3af POE, two Gigabit Ethernet ports and a USB port. Water and dust resistant, the A Series can be set on a desktop, mounted to an ethernet wall plate (EU, UK, US), installed on a wall or T-rail ceiling or fastened to an outdoor wall or pole.
hersteller_seite.strom: The A Series is PoE only and does not include a power supply. ... can also be powered by S Series Switches or any other 802.3af compliant PoE switch.
hersteller_seite.mesh: For optimal range, the A Series will mesh with other devices over the 2.4 GHz band only. Will not mesh with OM5P.
